```{r}
Read_count<- read.delim('/home/mad149/Read_count_file_Sept10 - Read_count_file(1).tsv', sep='\t', stringsAsFactors = TRUE)
Read_count <- Read_count[,c(1,4)]
```


```{r}

Water_data<- read.delim('/home/mad149/chapter_meta_analysis/metadata/Studies_salinity_metadata_All - Studies_salinity_metadata_water.csv.tsv', sep='\t', stringsAsFactors = TRUE)

Water_data$Salinity<- as.numeric(gsub( ',','.', Water_data$Salinity))
Water_data$pH<- as.numeric(gsub( ',','.',Water_data$pH))



xblast_output <- read.delim('/home/mad149/chapter_meta_analysis/xblast_output_Sept10.tsv', sep='\t', stringsAsFactors = TRUE)


merged_df_Aqua <- merge(Water_data, Read_count, by = "SRA_id")
merged_df_Aqua <- merge(merged_df_Aqua, xblast_output, by = "SRA_id")


merged_df_Aqua$Environment <- 'Aqueous'
merged_df_Aqua$Description[merged_df_Aqua$SRA_id == 'ERR864073' ] <- "Estuary"

#install.packages("readr")
library(readr)

# Write your data frame to a TSV file
write.table(merged_df_Aqua, file = "Studies_salinity_metadata_All_aquatic_Sept10.tsv", sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```

```{r Normalize_water}
merged_df_Aqua$Kef_subclade43954<-  ((merged_df_Aqua$Kef_subclade43954/merged_df_Aqua$Read_count)*1000000)/merged_df_Aqua$CPM_Ribosomal_count
merged_df_Aqua$Kef_subclade43914<-  ((merged_df_Aqua$Kef_subclade43914/merged_df_Aqua$Read_count)*1000000)/merged_df_Aqua$CPM_Ribosomal_count
merged_df_Aqua$Kef_subclade42396<-  ((merged_df_Aqua$Kef_subclade42396/merged_df_Aqua$Read_count)*1000000)/merged_df_Aqua$CPM_Ribosomal_count
merged_df_Aqua$Kef_subclade44582<-  ((merged_df_Aqua$Kef_subclade44582/merged_df_Aqua$Read_count)*1000000)/merged_df_Aqua$CPM_Ribosomal_count
merged_df_Aqua$Kef_subclade44712<-  ((merged_df_Aqua$Kef_subclade44712/merged_df_Aqua$Read_count)*1000000)/merged_df_Aqua$CPM_Ribosomal_count
merged_df_Aqua$Kef_group38142<-  ((merged_df_Aqua$Kef_group38142/merged_df_Aqua$Read_count)*1000000)/merged_df_Aqua$CPM_Ribosomal_count


merged_df_Aqua$Missing_kef<-  ((merged_df_Aqua$Missing_kef/merged_df_Aqua$Read_count)*1000000)/merged_df_Aqua$CPM_Ribosomal_count

merged_df_Aqua$total_CPA_noKef_count <- merged_df_Aqua$total_CPA_count - merged_df_Aqua$Kef_count

merged_df_Aqua$total_NaExp <- merged_df_Aqua$total_CPA_count + merged_df_Aqua$MnhE_count + merged_df_Aqua$Hppase_count + merged_df_Aqua$MtrA_count + merged_df_Aqua$NhaB_count + merged_df_Aqua$NhaC_count + merged_df_Aqua$NhaD_count + merged_df_Aqua$NqrA_count- merged_df_Aqua$Kef_count


merged_df_Aqua$total_KImp <- merged_df_Aqua$TrkH_count + merged_df_Aqua$Kdp_count + merged_df_Aqua$KimA_count + merged_df_Aqua$Kup_count
merged_df_Aqua$total_OsImp <- merged_df_Aqua$MIP_count + merged_df_Aqua$BCCT_count + merged_df_Aqua$OpuAC_count
merged_df_Aqua$total_MgImp <- merged_df_Aqua$MgtE_count + merged_df_Aqua$CorA_count 
merged_df_Aqua$total_Synth <- merged_df_Aqua$EctC_count + merged_df_Aqua$TreT_count + merged_df_Aqua$Trehalose_PPase_count 


cleanAqua <- merged_df_Aqua[!is.na(merged_df_Aqua$Salinity),]
```
